title: Trump Faces 4.2% Inflation Shock — OECD Says Fed Is Frozen - State Street Energy Select Sector SPDR ETF (ARCA:XLE), State Street Real Estate Select Sector SPDR ETF (ARCA:XLRE)
summary: The OECD report indicates a projected rise in both headline and core inflation in 2026, with the impact of higher energy prices outweighing the effect from declining tariff rates. GDP growth is expected to slow down due to decreasing real purchasing power and depleted household savings. The Federal Reserve is anticipated to keep rates steady, with other central banks potentially raising rates.
sentiment_reason: The sentiment is negative due to the projected rise in inflation and the deceleration of GDP growth, coupled with the Federal Reserve's decision to maintain the current interest rates.
